name: race-wars-tracker
description: High-competition motorsport telemetry and route recording app

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleDebug
scripts.build:bundle-release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
